faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Eastern Coalfields for filling up healthcare positions in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The positions available are for Medical Dresser (Trainee) under T&S Grade "E" salary structure.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 31 vacancies available for the Medical Dresser (Trainee) post across categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode by forwarding them through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application form is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Matric qualification along with a one-year training certificate from a company hospital, recognized institute, or government hospital.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Eastern Coalfields Medical Dresser?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a Trade Test conducted by the Medical Department under the supervision of CMS (I/C), Sanctoria Hospital ECL, HQ.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can find the link to download the official notification PDF in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Eastern Coalfields?
faq.answer: The official website of the organization is www.easterncoalfields.in where updates and forms can be found.
